key_decisions.decision: Follow the read verb prophesied and retain its musical setting.
Preserve the five written names and stated six rather than inserting Shimei without notice.
Retain all fourteen names and treat the final sequence as names in this roster.
Preserve the horn image and all seventeen children, noting the horn’s uncertain attachment.
Keep the family supervision and all instruments without excluding the just-mentioned daughters by addition.
Keep the shorter first entry and attach the explicit twelve to Gedaliah’s group.
Keep Izri rather than harmonizing Zeri in verse 3.
Keep Jesharelah’s differing form from Asharelah.
Keep Azarel’s name as this roster gives it.
Retain Shubael’s form in this entry.
